examples.vi: Bệnh nhân đã được đặt máy thở sau ca phẫu thuật.

senses.definition: an opening or machine that lets fresh air in and pushes dirty or stale air out of a space

examples.en: Make sure the kitchen ventilator is working properly while you cook.
examples.vi: Hãy đảm bảo máy thông gió nhà bếp hoạt động tốt khi bạn nấu ăn.

senses.vi: máy thông gió; bộ thông gió; cửa thông hơi

thesaurus.definition: a device (such as a fan) that introduces fresh air or expels foul air
a device that facilitates breathing in cases of respiratory failure

vi_block: Bộ thông gió, máy thông gió; quạt.

wiktionary.gloss: A device that circulates fresh air and expels stale or noxious air.
wiktionary.vi: máy thông gió; bộ thông gió

examples: Near-synonym: respirator
wiktionary.gloss: A machine that moves breathable air into and out of the lungs of a patient who is unable to breathe sufficiently.
Some behaviour or happening that relieves a tense atmosphere or situation.
Having white privilege.

thesaurus.definition: smallest of the three parts of the breastbone; articulates with the corpus sternum and the seventh rib

wiktionary.gloss: The small cartilaginous extension to the lower part of the sternum, usually ossified in the adult human.
wiktionary.vi: mỏ ác; mỏm kiếm; mỏm mũi kiếm

blocks.etymology: An alteration (influenced by hammer) of the earlier yelambre, yelamber, from Middle English *yelwambre, from yelwe (“yellow”) + *ambre (“yellowhammer”), from Old English amore, related to Old High German amaro (“yellowhammer”) (see modern German Ammer).

thesaurus.definition: large flicker of eastern North America with a red neck and yellow undersurface to wings and tail
European bunting the male being bright yellow

wiktionary.gloss: A passerine bird, Emberiza citrinella, of western Eurasia, which is mainly yellow in colour.

The northern flicker, Colaptes auratus, a woodpecker with yellow underwings and undertail and often other yellowish underparts; one of its ways of feeding is to hammer on trees to find insects (adults and larvae) to eat.
A native or resident of the American state of Alabama.
